plan.headline: Current MRR is the sum of monthly recurring revenue across live, paying subscriptions as of today, with trend and plan breakdown.

metrics.title: Current MRR
metrics.description: Sum of mrr_cents (shown in USD) across subscriptions that are live as of the as-of date: started on or before that date and not yet canceled. Test organizations are excluded if the assumption is on.

metrics.title: MRR over time
metrics.description: Month-end MRR for each month in the selected period, computed by summing mrr_cents of subscriptions live at the end of each month (started before it and not canceled before it).

metrics.title: MRR by plan tier
metrics.description: Current MRR split by plan tier (free, starter, team, business, enterprise). Subscriptions with no plan are grouped as Unknown.

assumptions.label: Exclude test accounts
assumptions.rationale: The data dictionary says test organizations (QA, demo, load-test) should be excluded from business metrics.

assumptions.label: Count trials
assumptions.rationale: Trialing subscriptions usually have not paid yet, so they are excluded from MRR by default.

assumptions.label: Count past-due
assumptions.rationale: Past-due customers are still subscribed and expected to pay, so they count toward MRR by default.

assumptions.label: Trend period
assumptions.rationale: Twelve months covers the full data history and shows the MRR trajectory without being noisy.

assumptions.label: Timezone
assumptions.rationale: Determines which instant counts as the as-of date and month-end boundaries; UTC is a neutral default.

events.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT ((:as_of::date) + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AS as_of_end) SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr_cents), 0) / 100.0, 2) AS value FROM northwind.subscriptions s JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = s.org_id CROSS JOIN params p WHERE s.started_at < p.as_of_end AND (s.canceled_at IS NULL OR s.canceled_at >= p.as_of_end) AND s.status <> 'canceled' AND (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR NOT o.is_test) AND (:include_trialing::boolean OR s.status <> 'trialing') AND (:include_past_due::boolean OR s.status <> 'past_due')
events.explanation: Sums mrr_cents/100 for subscriptions started by the end of the as-of date (in the chosen timezone) and not canceled, honoring the test-account, trialing and past-due toggles.

events.sql: WITH asof AS (SELECT ((:as_of::date) + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AS cutoff), live_subs AS (SELECT s.plan_id, s.mrr_cents FROM northwind.subscriptions s JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = s.org_id CROSS JOIN asof a WHERE s.started_at < a.cutoff AND (s.canceled_at IS NULL OR s.canceled_at >= a.cutoff) AND (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR o.is_test = false) AND (s.status = 'active' OR (s.status = 'past_due' AND :include_past_due::boolean) OR (s.status = 'trialing' AND :include_trialing::boolean))) SELECT COALESCE(p.tier, 'Unknown') AS label, round(SUM(l.mrr_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS value FROM live_subs l LEFT JOIN northwind.plans p ON p.id = l.plan_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.tier, 'Unknown') ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 20
events.explanation: Sums mrr_cents of subscriptions live at the end of the as-of date (started by then, not canceled), filtered by status toggles and test-account setting, grouped by plan tier with Unknown for missing plans.

events.sql: WITH months AS (SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('month', :date_range_start::date), date_trunc('month', (:date_range_end::date - 1)), interval '1 month')::date AS month_start), month_ends AS (SELECT month_start, LEAST(((month_start + interval '1 month')::date), :as_of::date + 1) AS boundary_date FROM months), subs AS (SELECT s.started_at, s.canceled_at, s.mrr_cents FROM northwind.subscriptions s JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = s.org_id WHERE (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR o.is_test = false) AND (s.status <> 'trialing' OR :include_trialing::boolean) AND (s.status <> 'past_due' OR :include_past_due::boolean)) SELECT m.boundary_date - 1 AS x, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr_cents), 0) / 100.0, 2) AS y FROM month_ends m LEFT JOIN subs s ON s.started_at < (m.boundary_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text) AND (s.canceled_at IS NULL OR s.canceled_at >= (m.boundary_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text)) GROUP BY m.boundary_date ORDER BY x
events.explanation: For each month in the range, sums mrr_cents of subscriptions started before the end of that month (or the as-of date for the current month) and not canceled by then, honoring test, trial and past-due toggles and the timezone.

review.summary: The query correctly sums mrr_cents for live, non-canceled subscriptions as of the end of the as-of day in the chosen timezone, honoring the test-account, trialing and past-due assumptions without join fanout.

review.summary: This query correctly sums current MRR by plan tier, counting live active and past-due subscriptions as of today, excluding trials and test organizations, and grouping missing plans as Unknown.

review.summary: The month-end MRR trend is roughly right, but trial and past-due exclusions use each subscription's current status, so historical months may include trials that were later canceled or exclude subscriptions that were paying then.

issues.message: Filters on s.status reflect today's status, not the status at each month-end. Trials that were later canceled have status='canceled' and are counted as paying MRR in past months, while subs that are trialing or past_due today are dropped from every past month. Label the chart as approximate, or use invoices (e.g. a paid invoice before the boundary) to approximate paying status.

The date_range_start of 2025-10-29 truncates to October 2025, so the first point is 2025-10-31. Data starts 2025-11-01, so that point will likely show near-zero and look like a false ramp-up. Consider starting months at date_trunc('month', :date_range_start) only once data exists.

date_trunc('month', <date>) resolves to the timestamptz overload, so the month series depends on the session timezone. Cast to ::timestamp first to keep month boundaries purely calendar-based before applying AT TIME ZONE :timezone.
